subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild channel allowlists support glob-pattern keys such as `ws-*`, and what precedence should they have relative to exact id/name/slug entries, disabled entries, thread-parent fallback, category inheritance, and literal `*`?
rationale: This is a user-facing config and authorization boundary change, and source inspection shows no existing contract that safely defines pattern syntax or precedence.

options.title: Approve narrow Discord glob contract
options.body: Define explicit glob syntax and precedence in the Discord plugin, then require schema, docs, and regression tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into access-control redesign
options.body: Keep #8972 open as input to the broader #69748/#60582 Discord config work instead of adding a separate pattern mechanism now.

options.title: Reject glob keys
options.body: Close the pattern request after documenting the supported alternatives such as exact entries, literal `*`, and any chosen category/access-list mechanism.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow Discord glob contract
recommendation.body: Define explicit glob syntax and precedence in the Discord plugin, then require schema, docs, and regression tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The most direct history for the shared matcher and Discord wildcard behavior points to steipete's prior work.
